_note: Best-guess shape only - NOT verified against the Fabric Eventstream schema. Author the stream once in the Fabric portal (Custom Endpoint source -> Eventhouse destination, table downtime_raw, ProcessedIngestion, JSON), run `python src/pdmops/setup/04_eventstream.py --capture <eventstreamId>` to overwrite this file with the real definition, review it, and commit. 04_eventstream.py re-targets the destination workspaceId/itemId/databaseName on every apply, so per-deployment IDs in the captured file never go stale. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before the definition is sent to Fabric.
